label: Maj. Florenz J. Mansmann
narrative: Florenz Mansmann is the corroborating witness for Robert Jacobs's Big Sur account, and he is on this board partly to correct a misattribution the board itself carried. His presence at the site is documented from a hostile source in the same way Jacobs's is: Kingston A. George, the project engineer, published a group photograph in the Skeptical Inquirer of Winter 1993 and captioned it, naming Major Florenz Mansmann and Chief Warrant Officer Guy Spooner in uniform in front of him. Mansmann later wrote to UFO researchers about the September 1964 filming, including a letter to Lee Graham in 1983 and a letter of May 1987 to T. Scott Crain that is reported as confirming Jacobs's account, and Jacobs wrote to him in January 1985. Those letters are Big Sur letters. The board's malmstrom-echo-flight-1967 node attributes letters of the same dates to a Col. Robert Mansmann said to have been involved in the Echo Flight technical investigation at Malmstrom, which is the wrong man and the wrong event; the correction is filed separately at research/leads/nuclear-corrections-2026-09-19.json.
